title: M/S Rathi Industies Ltd. v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Pritinker Diwaker, J. and Saral Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed following Dev Prayag Paper Mill.
headnote: Challenge to an additional-security demand and to clause (1) of para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires s.47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003 dismissed in terms of the lead judgment in M/s Dev Prayag Paper Mill (Pvt.) v. State of U.P. (Writ-C No. 30898 of 2016, 21.3.2017).
facts: M/s Rathi Industries Ltd. challenged a 31 October 2009 demand for additional security for electricity supply, warning of action on non-payment, and also assailed clause (1) of para 4.20 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as ultra vires section 47(5) of the Electricity Act, 2003. Interim protection against the demand was granted on 1 December 2009 and continued. At final hearing, counsel accepted that identical writs had already been dismissed in Dev Prayag Paper Mill.
